content_sections.heading: Department-wise Vacancies
content_sections.text: The District Medical & Health Office South West Khasi Hills has announced a total of 9 vacancies distributed across three posts:

rows.post_name: Ayush MO (National Program for Prevention and Management of Osteoarthritis & Musculoskeletal, Integration of Ayush with National Programme for Prevention and Control of Cancer, Diabetes, Cardiovascular Diseases and Stroke (NPCDCS), Ayurvidya Health Lifestyle through AYUSH for School Children)

rows.qualification: 1. Candidate should possess a BHMS/ BAMS degree from any recognized University.2. Registered with Board/ Council of Homoeopathy Medicine, Meghalaya (mandatory for BHMS).3. Candidate should have a valid Registered License from Meghalaya State Council of Indian System of Medicine (MCISM) (mandatory for BAMS).
Minimum Qualification: Diploma in Yoga from a recognised Institute.
1. B. Pharm (Ayur)/ D. Pharm in Ayurveda & Pharmacy from recognised Institute.2. Should have a valid registration certificate.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms
content_sections.text: The selected candidates will be engaged on a contractual basis for a period of 11 months, which may be renewable. The fixed monthly remuneration is Rs. 40,000/- for Ayush MO, Rs. 20,000/- for Yoga Professional, and Rs. 15,000/- for Pharmacist. Upper age limit is 32 years, relaxable by 5 years for SC/ST candidates as per OM No.Mo.PER.38/2021/30. Dated 03/02/2022.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for DMHO South West Khasi Hills Ayush MO
content_sections.text: Obtain the standard application form and compile all required academic and professional certificates, proof of date of birth, SC/ST certificate, passport size photographs duly attested, and current contact details including address, mobile number, and email address. Arrange the application in the prescribed order: Standard Form with passport size photograph duly attested, Self-Attested photocopies of all academic and professional qualifications, Proof of Date of Birth, and SC/ST Certificate. Submit the completed application in person or by post at the 10-Bedded Integrated Ayush Hospital, Mawkyrwat on or before 30 October 2026 up to 5:00 PM.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: Standard Form with passport size photograph duly attested Self-Attested photocopies of all academic and professional qualifications Proof of Date of Birth SC/ST Certificate Registration certificate / Council license where applicable

faq.question: Q1. Is this job permanent or on contract, and for how long?
faq.answer: The engagement is on a contractual basis for an initial period of 11 months, which may be renewable.

faq.question: Q2. Who is eligible for age relaxation and how much is it?
faq.answer: The upper age limit is 32 years, and it is relaxable by 5 years specifically for SC/ST candidates as per OM No.Mo.PER.38/2021/30 dated 03/02/2022.

faq.question: Q3. Which documents must be attached with the application form?
faq.answer: Applicants must attach a standard form with an attested passport-size photograph, self-attested photocopies of academic and professional qualifications, proof of date of birth, and an SC/ST certificate.

faq.question: Q4. What is the last date to submit the application?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application is 30 October 2026 up to 5:00 PM.

faq.question: Q5. Where should the application form be submitted?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted at the 10-Bedded Integrated Ayush Hospital, Mawkyrwat.
